diagram_review.result: No existing TikZ diagrams or diagram failures were reported. Candidate figures are source-supported opportunities, not requirements. No unsupported map, orientation, index, or sign assertions were found in inspected diagram-bearing material.

diagram_candidates.claim: Four compactified intervals in M̄(a,d) have eight once-broken endpoints, each factoring through b or c; all-plus counts give δa=2b+2c, δb=δc=2d, and δ²a=8d.
diagram_candidates.kind: TikZ schematic of four interval components and their broken-trajectory endpoint labels.
diagram_candidates.why: The pairing of eight endpoints into four intervals and the coherent sign cancellation are central to the counterexample.
diagram_candidates.draw_or_check: Show four separate closed intervals; label endpoints by the trajectory pair through b or c and show coherent endpoint products opposite within each interval. Separately annotate the all-plus algebra. Do not imply a specific torus trajectory picture.

diagram_candidates.claim: The invariant inner equator v=π contains trajectories from saddle a=(π/2,π) to saddle b=(3π/2,π); on the open interval T Wᵘ(a)=T Wˢ(b)=R∂u.
diagram_candidates.kind: TikZ torus/phase schematic or local annular chart.
diagram_candidates.why: The shared stable and unstable tangent line is the geometric failure of transversality.
diagram_candidates.draw_or_check: Mark inner equator, both saddles, flow direction, and coincident stable/unstable arcs. Keep open orbit interval distinct from critical endpoints; do not suggest the full torus is depicted.

diagram_candidates.claim: A local finger move makes A and B meet at p=(ρ,0,0,0,0,0) and q=(−ρ,0,0,0,0,0); tangent determinants differ by sign(2e₁), giving opposite local intersection signs.
diagram_candidates.kind: Local finger-move schematic with oriented intersection signs.
diagram_candidates.why: A picture can connect the explicit graph-cap construction to the opposite-sign pair and subsequent Whitney cancellation.
diagram_candidates.draw_or_check: Show A as reference sheet and B as pushed cap crossing twice; label p,q and opposite signs. Mention Whitney circle separately. Do not portray the 3-spheres as literal 2D surfaces or omit simple-connectivity/stable-range hypotheses for cancellation.

diagram_candidates.claim: K occupies one local saddle sector at q; cutting off that quarter-sector removes q and yields cK−sK=1 from boundary degree.
diagram_candidates.kind: Two-panel local saddle and homoclinic-disk schematic.
diagram_candidates.why: One-sector occupancy, the cut arc, boundary orientation and index count are key geometric steps.
diagram_candidates.draw_or_check: Panel one: axes xy=0, field direction, occupied quadrant x,y≥0, cut arc and endpoint order. Panel two: resulting positively oriented loop, interior centers/saddles, q excluded, and degree sum +1.

existing_diagram_checks.check: Four intervals each have two endpoints; all-plus gives δ²a=2(2d)+2(2d)=8d≠0, while coherent endpoint signs cancel per interval.
Using the displayed metric and field, v=π is invariant, the open segment runs from a to b, and both tangent spaces are R∂u; nontransversality follows.
At e₁=±ρ the tangent determinant changes by sign(2e₁), confirming opposite transverse intersection signs.
For X=c(x,y)(x,−y), the stated cut arc and retained orbit are nonopposing; positive boundary turning and local center/saddle indices give cK−sK=1 with q excluded.
